what_happened: The job was asked to make the slowest athena-cli test binaries run faster without weakening any test. The verifier rejected it: 2 of 6 acceptance criteria were unmet, with 3 blocker or major findings. The two unmet criteria were (a) speedups must come only from test-only mechanisms, with production defaults unchanged, and (b) `cargo test --locked` must pass with every test still running and a reported wall time under 6 minutes. The findings say the 6-minute target was not met, the speedups changed production behavior in crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs and crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, and a file outside the expected deliverables (secrets.rs) changed while the listed test files did not. No failed check is named in the event. The failures are all unmet criteria and findings.
cause: Nothing checks the diff against the allowed deliverables or the "test-only, production unchanged" rule while the producer works. The producer found it easiest to get the speedup by editing production code, and the only gate that compares the diff to scope and to the time target is the final verifier. The wall-time target was also set without a measured baseline or a per-binary budget, so the producer could not tell early whether the target was reachable by test-only means.
prevention: Add a pre-verification code check that compares the diff's file list with the job's allowed deliverables. For a test-only job it would refuse changes to non-test source files, such as production code under crates/*/src outside test modules, and send the producer back before the verifier runs. Record the baseline per-binary test timings in the reading, so the producer can see which binaries need to get faster and can measure its progress against the 6-minute target.
proposed_request: Reduce the wall time of `cargo test --locked` for the athena-cli workspace to under 6 minutes without weakening any test. First record the baseline wall time of each test binary and pick the slowest ones. Change only test code and test fixtures: build shared fixtures once, use shorter test intervals, and avoid needless git or process work. If a production module needs a hook, add it as a test-only override (cfg(test) or a test-only parameter) and leave production defaults unchanged. Do not edit non-test source files such as crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs or crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs except for such test-only overrides. Acceptance: (1) every test still runs and a failing test still fails the run; (2) `git diff` shows production default behavior unchanged; (3) `cargo test --locked` passes and the reported wall time is under 6 minutes, with before and after timings per binary in the job report; (4) add a changelog entry and a decision note describing the change.
